messages:
Matt: Heads-up — our nightly canary is getting evicted ~10m in due to preemptible TTL. Anyone seen quota/softlock changes from VendorX? cc @Sarah @Kevin

Sarah: Saw 2 evictions last night, logs show `preemptible_termination` within 7h of launch. Canary does a long warmup.

Kevin: We've been on VendorX preemptible plan with TTL=6h. Can we ask them to extend to 12h for the canary window? That would avoid mid-run kills but may cost more.

Matt: Filing PR to change autoscaler to prefer non-preemptible during rollout window — infra PR #4952. But the real win is a vendor softlock so instances aren't reclaimed mid-canary. @Jen do you have the vendor contact?

Jen: Pinged our rep, opened ticket VG-3371. They asked for the fleet tag + timing window.

Matt: Fleet tag: `redwood-demo-nightly-canary`. Timing: daily 02:00-04:00 UTC. Ideally we need a 4h hold starting 02:00.

Sarah: Adding the suggested nodepool config snippet for clarity (vendor-facing):
```
# vendor nodepool hint
nodePool:
  name: demo-canary
  preemptible: true
  preemptibleTTL: 6h
  holdWindow:
    start: "02:00"
    duration: "4h"
  minNonPreemptible: 1
```

Kevin: OK that's vendor-ish config (not literal k8s). For our autoscaler we'll set nodeSelector + podAntiAffinity and a minPool override during the window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4952

vendor-gpu-bot: VendorX update on VG-3371 — we can extend softlock to 8h for fleet `redwood-demo-nightly-canary` for the next 72 hours while you validate. Permanent change ETA 3 business days. Contact: rep@vendorx.com

Matt: Amazing, thanks. Can someone approve the infra PR to set `minNonPreemptible: 1`? Needs ops approval before the window tonight.

Jen: On it. Approving now and will add VG-3371 ticket ref to the PR description.

Sarah: I'll monitor tonight's run and report evictions. If we still see terminations, we'll escalate and fall back to dedicated for the window.

Kevin: Quick FYI — cost estimate ~+$120/day if we keep 1 reserved non-preemptible for the 2h nightly window. Finance gave a tentative greenlight for a 2-week trial.

Matt: Noted, will add budget note to the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
